verdict.rationale: Bland offers LLM-judge Evals to grade call quality and an MCP integration that can 'query analytics' on your account data, which are AI-generated evaluative outputs derived from your call data, but there's no dedicated insights/suggestions dashboard or proactive recommendation feature described. Missing for 10: a native analytics/insights UI, evidence of proactive suggestions surfaced to users, and independent confirmation of these AI-generated insights in practice.
